events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in 1969.

angles.name: Summer of Love vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the original Summer of Love, we're taking it back to Max Yasgur's farm. What's your top Woodstock moment?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, today. His music and legend live on, 49 years since we lost him.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55, was tragically shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur today. His powerful lyrics and legacy continue to resonate, 30 years on.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84, and passed away on this day.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix today. His revolutionary guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Pretenders Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the voice of a generation, Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' in 1975, a song that continues to inspire.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Over five decades of 'Imagine'. John Lennon's powerful message of peace and unity still resonates deeply.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the groundbreaking first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remember the iPod?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the iPod changed everything. Who remembers their first one and what was on it?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy franchise and its enduring legacy.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme song? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58 today. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What are your hidden gems from the tracklist?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80, and passed away on this day.

angles.name: Queen's King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His incredible voice and showmanship remain unmatched.
